items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Because I was doing studio work and I got hired by Jerry Fielding to do “The Groucho Marx Show.”

ctx.x: You were pretty much one of the first black musicians to get into the studios.
Probably on a steady basis, yeah. Because I was doing studio work and I got hired by Jerry Fielding to do “The Groucho Marx Show.” That was at CBS at first and then moved to NBC. “You Bet Your Life.”
